episodes.title: The Zizians Death Cult, Antifa and the Rise of Far Left Violence with Andy Ngo
episodes.description:
Andy Ngo was beaten so badly in Portland that he suffered a brain hemorrhage. Two years later he went back undercover, was recognized, and nearly died a second time. He now lives in London and it's no longer safe to go home.

The far left violence he's experienced is not rare and often its supported or even encouraged by the media and far left politicians. 

In this episode of The Sovereign Sphere, Andy Ngo takes us behind the curtain of Antifa, the rise of far left violence and his shocking discovery of The Zizians, a trans death cult. 

We also get into:

• What's actually driving the riots in Europe 
• The LFI member of parliament with a criminal conviction for political violence, still sitting in government
• What happened in Seattle when a mayor handed six city streets to armed checkpoints
• The Zizians — a trans death cult with at least eight known deaths, members recruited from the University of Waterloo, who believed they could upload their consciousness into a superintelligent AI and "save the world" by killing people
• Why Canadian media identified a mass shooter as "a female in a dress" — and left out what was wrapped around the barrel of the gun
• How leftist media hides far left violence 

Watch to the end. The last five minutes are about a story that is very much not over.
